title: Interop harness against Stalwart (real JMAP server)
description: First: inventory what external-server interop crate-jmap already has (grep found no clear Stalwart/Cyrus/James harness; confirm). Then add an opt-in (feature- or env-gated, not default CI) harness that runs crate-jmap clients (mail, calendars, contacts, sharing, filenode as supported) against a local Stalwart instance, and differential tests that send the same requests to a crate-jmap memory server and to Stalwart and diff the responses modulo ids/states. Record each divergence as a bead with the spec text that decides it.
